::: {.module2-timeline-table}
+--------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|Week                                              |In your timetabled session                                                                               |Before the next session                                                                             |
+==================================================+=========================================================================================================+====================================================================================================+
| **Weeks 2–3**                                    | - **Form your group:** Join a Report 1 research group in Canvas.                                        | - **Choose a direction:** Review projects.                                                         |
| [10–23 August]{.module2-week-date}               | - All group members must be in the same practical.                                                      | - Make sure all group members are in the correct Canvas group.                                     |
+--------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Week 4**                                       | - **Plan and pilot:** Develop a hypothesis and predictions.                                             | - **Run the pilot:** Complete it before Week 5.                                                    |
|[24–30 August]{.module2-week-date}                |- Design the main experiment, sketch the expected graph, and identify analysis.                          |- Everyone contributes; begin literature and report notes.                                          |
|                                                  | - Draft data sheets and equipment needs; plan the pilot and collect equipment.                          |                                                                                                    |
+--------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|**Week 5**                                        |- **Refine and run:** Discuss what the pilot revealed and finalise the design.                           |- **Run the main experiment:** Collect data as a group.                                             |
| [31 August–6 September]{.module2-week-date}      | - Confirm response and explanatory variables and the analysis; collect remaining equipment.             | - Maintain one shared workbook with metadata and clean data sheets.                                |
+--------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|**Week 6**                                        |- **Use the period for project work**                                                                    |- **Finish data collection:** Complete the experiment and collate before Week 7.                    |
| [7–13 September]{.module2-week-date}             | - There is no structured practical activity.                                                            |                                                                                                    |
|                                                  | - Complete project work, troubleshoot, and organise the group dataset.                                  |                                                                                                    |
+--------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Week 7**                                       | - **Analyse and interpret:** Spend no more than 30 minutes finalising the dataset.                      | - **Begin the report:** Finish analyses and graphs.                                                |
| [14–20 September]{.module2-week-date}            | - Individually plot, analyse, and interpret in R or SPSS; choose figures and statistics.                | - Draft Introduction, Methods, and Results; use report instructions and rubric.                    |
+--------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|**Week 8**                                        |- **Finalise submission:** Use writing guidance and finalise analyses, statistical output, and figures.  |- **Submit both components**                                                                        |
|[21–27 September]{.module2-week-date}             |- Prepare the group workbook with metadata, clean data, and supporting worksheets.                       |- One group member submits the group data file.                                                     |
|                                                  | - Each student completes their own report.                                                              | - Every student submits their individual report.                                                   |
|                                                  |                                                                                                         | - Friday 25 September at 23:59.                                                                    |
+--------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
:::
